meta.name: Phrase Shop
meta.notes: Cream and ink-brown stay fixed; --c-primary marks the rolling sentence words, underlines, cart count, tags, buttons and the CTA panel, and its tints make the product photo pads.

issues: Signature sentence only had two words (category, label); the brief's price threshold ('onder € 50') was missing entirely, so the 'shop entrance' felt half-built
Changing a word on the homepage only rolled the CTA count; the editorial product grid right below ignored the sentence
Product/hero pads mixed 7% primary into the surface: with a red brand (Spaansen, Kartstore) every pad turned salmon-pink, fighting the warm cream art direction
Mobile: horizontal overflow from the absolutely positioned roller options (opacity 0 but still in layout) plus body-only overflow clip
Mobile two-up cards: the 42px quick-add stole the name column, cutting single long words ('Tuinmeubelen') mid-letter
Hero sentence was not dominant enough versus the intro headline above it; generic 'section + chips' feel on the catalog besides the sticky phrase
fixed: Added a third rolling word derived from content prices: thresholds that actually split the range (max 4, e.g. 'onder € 50 / € 250'), shown only when there are ≥2 priced products, hidden without JS; it feeds the CTA odometer, the URL (?p=) and the catalog filter (class-based so it stacks on the shop runtime), with live count text
Homepage grid now answers the sentence: non-matching products step back (grayscale, 32% opacity) while matches stay in ink
Pads re-tinted to a near-neutral warm cream (3% primary on #F0E8DB, 8% on hover) so any brand palette keeps the editorial calm
html overflow-x:clip on both pages removes the mobile horizontal scroll
Mobile cards: quick-add docks as a round button on the pad's corner, names get full width and wrap instead of being cut
Hero sentence enlarged (up to 6.2rem) so the phrase is unmistakably the entrance
